ground: Baskarta contours and spot heights outside the river crop; flat 3.5 m inside it, blending over terrain_blend_m

terrain.datum: Not confirmed from the product description; assumed RH 2000 (RH 70 differs by well under half a metre in Gothenburg). Shore heights sit near 0 m.

contents: water, land surface and quay walls; inside the river crop also the river bake's buildings, roads, gardens, trees and bridge (A3.3); outside it buildings, container cranes, port masts, channel marks and trees (A3.5a)

dressing.assumptions: Footprints, crane, mast and mark positions and tagged heights are OSM. Untagged heights: houses 5.5 m eaves with a gable roof on near-rectangular footprints, sheds and garages 2.8 m, tanks 14 m, other buildings 8-14 m by area. Walls sink 0.6 m below the lowest corner. Container cranes are a raised-boom blockout at the mapped 118 m (also used where untagged), boom toward the nearest water; lighting masts 30 m; marks are 3.5-4.5 m piles in their mapped colour on a 1.5 m carved rock where they stand in water. Buildings within 150 m of Nya Älvsborg are stone. Trees are an authored scatter (11 m lattice, 80 m value noise) on ground at least 3 m high and under 24 degrees, 6 m from shore and clear of buildings, roads and the port; not mapped vegetation. Colours are authored.
